scope: Production BrightScript region/transform captures, independently checked with shared mesh joint projections and decoded source-image alpha. Host evidence, not a Roku GPU screenshot or measured device FPS.
draw_budget: One tail submission, followed by complete body poses, then one pectoral submission; unchanged maximum six fish transforms/frame.
root_data: tools/tail_rig.py extracts shared body/caudal vertices from each existing mesh and their four baked bend poses. Projected points are cached at asset load.
fix: Anchor the tail to its actual model joint after width interpolation.
Keep neck height fixed rather than resizing it from a changing crop.
Reserve a small underlap and paint the body over the root.
Use the body's rounded origin on integer-only graphics backends.
limitations: Actual on-device filtering and appearance still need confirmation.
